component.name: Bel
component.summary: Loudness and spectrum metering for mixing, mastering and delivery

description.p: Bel is a free and open-source loudness and spectrum analyzer: an arrangeable canvas of meter modules driven by presets, delivery targets and skins.

Loudness follows EBU R 128 and ITU-R BS.1770-4 — momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, loudness range, and true peak by four-times oversampling — and is held against the EBU Tech 3341 and 3342 conformance vectors on every build. What Bel has not measured it does not draw: an unavailable quantity is a dash, never a zero.

ul.li: Number Box, LUFS Meter, Digital Meter and Super Meter
VU Meter with a real second-order movement
Spectrum Analyzer, Spectrogram, Phase Scope and Stereo Cloud

description.p: Files can be analysed offline against a delivery target, from the application or from the bundled command-line analyser. A tablet on the same network can mirror the canvas as a second display.
